Work targets and numeric series

A repair subject is an instrument, account, location or statistical subject. Field groups count different field labels within each subject. Models, sources and recording intervals remain separate versions; matching field labels do not prove that their values are equivalent. “Subjects with eligible data” counts subjects with at least one passing numeric field; other fields retain their saved results. Unresolved identities may still contain duplicates.

Different countries, products, contracts and measured quantities remain separate. Annual or monthly statistics cannot meet a 15-minute requirement simply by downloading them again.

Account subjects also include authors found inside quoted or reposted material. This is not a count of fully scraped account timelines.
